notes: Building Center presents this as a brand entry (parent Modine, page-listed related brands Airedale, Atherion, Hot Dawg, Modine, Valedictorian) with its own three serial styles, so it is shipped as a brand file; the page-listed related brands are NOT claimed to share this serial system and no usesStylesOf is used. Style 2 ships year-only: its year digits are text-stated but its month is a 3rd-character letter under a chart that exists only as an image and is not guessed.

styles.era: 14-character serials, 6 digits + 3 letters + 5 digits, year + month
styles.notes: Page positions 1st-4th numerical digits = year (4-digit year, used as-is), 5th-6th numerical digits = month, converted to [0,4] and [4,6].

styles.era: 9- to 10-character serials, 2 digits + 4-5 letters + 3 digits, year-only (month chart is image-only)
styles.notes: Page description says 5 letters (10 characters) but its own example 97JKGK153 has 4 letters (9 characters); both forms give the same year (1st-2nd digits = 97) and the same month letter (3rd character = J), and the combined pattern is disjoint from styles 1 and 3 in this file, so both lengths are encoded per the list-vs-detail lesson rather than picking a winner. Year positions [0,2]. Month is the 3rd character letter decoded via a chart that exists only as an image (Style-2_AAON-Date-of-Manufacture_Serial-Number-Nomenclature.png); per the year-only precedent the year ships and the month is held as an image-pass item, not guessed.

Page positions 6th-7th numerical digits = year, 8th-9th numerical digits = month (1-based), applied as character positions [5,7] and [7,9]. Digit-only counting is impossible here (only 5 numerical digits, so 6th-7th numerical digits do not exist), which confirms character counting for this style.
